description:
Do Nashville in style: stay at the VIP suite, and book a private parking!

★ 7 mn walk to Bdway, 14 mn to Nissan Stadium bridge      
★ 6 real beds  (no futon, all comfort)      ★ Private  balcony
★ Gym, with huge climbing wall                ★ Secure, fun bldg  
★ 3 LARGE Roku smart TVs                           ★ Free wifi
★ Resort outdoor POOL, year round       ★ Option to reserve a garage Parking  
★ Firepits & grill

 STR #2018073614

The space
Located poolside, where all the action is, the unit provides relaxation inside the cozy layout and with proper beds: the living room offers 1 Queen size bed and 2 singles (one in the trundle); one bedroom suite features 2 singles that could be moved together to create a King - European style, and a full bath with a soaking tub, while the other bedroom suite has a true King and the walk-in shower bathroom -- all with exceptional, cooling mattresses for your beauty rest. The ample proportions make for an easy, comfortable stay with your friends and family. One thing to note: while the apartment is lined with large and tall windows, the bedrooms do not have a window, just an opening in the wall, that you can easily close with black-out curtains. They do have a door for privacy.

Guest access
As our guests, you will have access to all the world-class amenities of the Burnham, as long as your name is on the Airbnb reservation: resort- style outdoor pool (open all year round) with sun chairs and cabanas (these are extra, let us know if you'd like to reserve one), a shaded courtyard where you can barbecue, a 2-level, windowed gym with a climbing wall, weights and a studio, as well as the penthouse lounge with its wet bar and city views terrace. 
We may be able to reserve parking spots for your stay in the garage for $30 per night per car. Please let us know as soon as possible how many spots you will need, and we will confirm availability and make the reservation for you.

Other things to note
The DOOR app will be your key-less sesame to enter every space, including your unit, elevator 2 and 3 (the main elevator is open to all), the garage gate if you rented parking spaces, and all the building amenities. You will want each guest to have it on their phone to go in and out freely.
(If you do not wish to use a smart phone, door codes are also available for convenient entry.)

We love children and warmly embrace guests with little ones. Yet, we recognize that our home may not be entirely "childproof" for toddlers, and we want to be transparent about it. 

Kindly be aware that this building is centrally located in downtown Nashville. We cannot assume responsibility for any uncontrollable external factors, including noise, private or public events, construction, etc., that may occur in the vicinity during your stay. This is a multifamily complex where the management oversees the amenities, common areas, and maintenance of both the exterior and shared interior spaces. This includes the upkeep of appliances and the physical condition of the apartment, covering aspects such as plumbing, electrical, pool, HVAC, and more. It's important to note that these elements are beyond our personal control. We are obligated to adhere to the building's protocols regarding maintenance issues and timelines for resolution.

We take care (and pride) in all other aspects personally, to provide a delightful stay. Our commitment is to create a fantastic experience and to ensure that your time in Nashville is not just a stay but a chance to truly immerse yourself in the local lifestyle!

Please note that the building amenities, including the pool, grills, gym, courtyard, and fire pits, may be subject to closure/maintenance. While such occurrences are rare, please take note of this before booking, as we regretfully cannot offer refunds for any instances of unavailability.
